---

## Overview

STICKnoLOGIC is a personal portfolio and creative hub that combines software development, digital art, and writing.

The website serves as a central space for:
- Web development and software engineering work
- Project showcases and case studies
- Technical and non-technical writing
- Digital artwork and visual experiments
- Personal reflections and creative literature
- A professional résumé and identity landing page

---

## Identity

STICKnoLOGIC is a Web Developer & Digital Artist who builds and explores software systems, web applications, and creative digital works.

The site reflects a multidisciplinary approach combining engineering, design, and expressive writing.
